subject.title: [Feature]: Fallback approval mode + model attribution in messages

question: Should OpenClaw add a core opt-in approval gate before executing configured model fallbacks, and if so what config scope, timeout behavior, and approval delivery surface should own it?
rationale: The remaining request changes fallback runtime behavior and adds operator-facing config; repository policy treats fallback behavior and config/default surfaces as compatibility- and product-sensitive.

options.title: Design a default-off core fallback gate
options.body: Add an explicit approval contract for configured fallback chains with documented timeout/fail/proceed semantics and focused schema/runtime/docs tests.

options.title: Keep fallback automatic
options.body: Treat current fallback notices and responsePrefix attribution as the supported model visibility/control path and close the approval-gate direction as not planned.

options.title: Define an extension hook first
options.body: Route fallback approval through a generic plugin or approval event API before adding a core model config knob.

recommendation.title: Design a default-off core fallback gate
recommendation.body: Add an explicit approval contract for configured fallback chains with documented timeout/fail/proceed semantics and focused schema/runtime/docs tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across fallback notices, model-failover docs, and the affected fallback/runtime surface.
